title: Harness self-validation should run against the rebuilt local harness binary
wanted_capability: When editing bro-harness turn machinery, developers should have a narrow workflow or tool hook to rebuild and exercise a nested/local harness session from the current worktree, so behavior changes can be smoke-tested against the new binary without replacing or restarting the active fleet session.
fallback_used: Relied on unit tests and noted that the live fleet session kept using the pre-change harness binary, so repeated HARNESS_EVENT messages during validation were expected until reinstall/restart.
evidence: current session: terminal promise_wait results were followed by stale HARNESS_EVENT messages because the running harness process was pre-change
